01 — My Story

Not the path I
was handed —
the one I chose.

I grew up in Bhalwal, Sargodha. Not as developed as Lahore, not as loud. It doesn’t have everything — but it’s mine and I love it. I loved computers before I knew what engineering was. When CE became an option, it was never a question.

First semester hit different from what I expected. All-nighters before mids and finals. PF and AICT labs built from scratch. A full day navigating an unfamiliar Lahore to repair my laptop — nothing to eat but a packet of grains the whole day, the bus back sold out but still running, then 4km on foot through Faisalabad. A Honahaar Scholarship trip with document complications I hadn’t expected. A groupmate I got close to transferred to Lahore. I lost focus for a while. Then I studied harder than I ever had before.

I finished with a CGPA of 3.91 — 2nd highest in my class. Second semester is online now. Wars, petrol prices, Eid. Studying from home. But I’m still here, and I’m not stopping.
